# Synthetic datasets

**All data in this folder is synthetic**, generated by the OT Sentinel Twin simulator. It does not describe any real
facility or equipment.

| File | Generator | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `<code>_<scenario>_seed1337.csv` | `scripts/generate_dataset.py --seed 1337` | 120 s normal → 240 s scenario → 60 s recovery, 2 Hz |
| `evaluation_results.json` | `scripts/run_evaluation.py` | full evaluation output (per-run alerts, summary, coverage matrix, robustness sweep) |

## CSV columns

- `seq`, `t_s`, `timestamp` — sample index, simulated seconds, ISO timestamp (simulated epoch 2026-01-01).
- `label` — ground truth: `normal` or the active scenario id (only while the fault is active).
- One column per reported signal (e.g. `sensor.primary_level`, `flow.inlet_lps`, `pump.running`), plus
  `<signal>.quality` and `<signal>.age_s` (source-timestamp age) for level, flow and pressure transmitters.
- `truth.*` — physical ground truth (level, flows, overflow, line pressure, inlet valve position). Not visible to the
  detector.
- `derived.*` — detector analytics (mass-balance residual per level transmitter, disagreement, anomaly score).
- `alerts_raised` — rule ids raised at that sample (`;`-separated).

Regenerate deterministically with the commands above.
